subject: Next steps: vendor onboarding & PO timeline for StackStream trial
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Asha Patel <asha.patel@stackstream.ai>, Ben Townsend <ben.t@stackstream.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 16:23:00 -0800
Subject: Next steps: vendor onboarding & PO timeline for StackStream trial

Hi Asha & Ben,

Thanks again for a productive call this afternoon. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

- What we covered: trial scope (500k tokens/month, dedicated model variant), success metrics (latency <= 300ms p95, accuracy measured on your sample eval set), and integration points (backend webhook + SDK).
- Decision criteria you called out: price per token, SLA for latency, and data residency controls.
- Primary economic buyer: you mentioned Rajat (CFO) — can you confirm?

Requests / next steps I can action:
1) I attached a short SOW draft to capture trial scope and dates (Redwood-Stackstream-SOW-draft-v1.pdf). Please review and flag any changes.
2) Can you introduce the procurement/vendor onboarding contact so we can get the vendor form, PO cadence, and required docs (W-9, SOC 2) on file?
3) Confirm target PO date (you mentioned early December) and preferred billing contact.

If it helps, our typical procurement flow is: vendor form -> W-9 + bank details -> DPA/SOW review -> PO issuance -> invoice (Net30). We support invoicing against a PO number and can include the PO on the invoice.

Would love a confirmation of the procurement contact and whether Rajat is the final approver. If procurement is fine with the quick SOW I attached, we can aim for PO by 2026-12-08 and a Jan 4 kickoff.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes

- Payment terms: our standard is Net30, and we do invoicing against PO numbers via our AP portal. Please confirm you can accept Net30 invoices with PO reference.

Two asks for you: please send W-9 + SOC2 statement and confirm bank details for ACH. Also can you flag any contractual items in the SOW you anticipate needing redlines for?

Hi Camila — procurement here. Thanks for the intro, Ben. Below are the items we need to start setup for Redwood as a vendor: 

1) Completed vendor onboarding form (link below) — includes legal name, EIN, remittance address.
2) W-9 (signed) — for our records.
3) Bank details or vendor portal enrollment for ACH payments.
4) Proof of SOC 2 Type II (or comparable attestation) covering cloud-hosted services.
5) Draft SOW / contract (we will send to Legal for review once above docs are present).

Payment/process notes:
- Our terms are Net30 by default; we can do earlier if negotiated.
- We require the PO number included on the invoice; our AP portal will validate the PO before releasing payment.
- Please confirm whether Redwood requires a minimum invoice amount or has any tiered billing that might affect our AP system.

Links:
- Vendor form: https://vendor.stackstream.ai/forms/onboard?ref=camila
- AP portal info: https://ap.stackstream.ai/docs/vendor-guidelines

Please attach the W-9 and SOC2 PDF to your reply and fill out the vendor form. Once we have those, we’ll aim to issue an initial PO by 2026-12-08.
